text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Deputy Jassim al-Kharafi, a former finance minister, to run for speaker's post. Kharafi will be running against opposition veteran Ahmad al-Saadoun, the speaker of the outgoing parliament, analysts say.
- New cabinet to be announced in 72 hours.
- Prime minister continues consultations with a number of deputies over forming the new cabinet.
- Kuwait Investment Authority sells 24 percent of its shares in local firm, Securities Group, to Kuwaiti investors.
- Burgan Bank and Bank of Kuwait and the Middle East reach preliminary agreement on merger.
- Fifty-five companies to take part in national products exhibition on October 30.
- New ministers likely to enjoy expanded power.
